items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: You know Wayne Shorter said something about composition is improvising in slow motion...

ctx.x: Especially at Christmastime, right. Oh this is a good 35 Christmas carols. If I hear somebody play a spare part of a song, like “Frankie and Johnny,” if there’s a bridge, I © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

will try to answer that person by doing a quote from the bridge. That’s my drill. But the spare parts. I love it. That’s, to me, when somebody does that, when someone takes a snip of another song and puts it in on the fly in real time into the song, and then goes back to what they were doing — oh where was I — that’s a pretty high level of human expression if you think about it. They were already improvising over chords, a new melody in real time, not the slow motion composition. You know Wayne Shorter said…
